exchangeFormat: 7th-area (WA/OR/ID/MT/WY/NV/UT/AZ): RST + 5-char state+county code (e.g. ORDES; county-line e.g. UTRIC/IDBEA or ORDES/JEF). Non-7th-area: RST + 2-char state/province/'DX'. Bands 160-10m. CW/Phone/Digital (NO WSJT/FT8 — exchange unsupported). 7th-area works everyone; others work 7th-area only.

scoringRules.scoreFormula: Σ QSO pts × Σ mults (counted ONCE PER CONTEST). Pts: SSB 2, CW 3, Digital 4 (RTTY/PSK=Digital). 7th-area entrant mult = each US state (50) + each Canadian province (13) + each other DXCC entity worked; an in-area station's 5-char code contributes its leading 2-char STATE token (ORDES → OR). Non-7th-area entrant mult = distinct 7th-area county codes (259). 7th-area works everyone for pts; non-7th-area scores 7th-area contacts only. 7th-area mobiles / county-line entries = new QSO + new county per code. Workable once per band per mode-class (CW/Phone/Digital). Claimed/running — the 7QP committee re-adjudicates. NOT enforced (claimed): DXCC-entity 'maximum of 10' cap (each entity counted; over-count only if >10 distinct DX entities); county-line code logged as one slashed token vs separate per-county entries (rules permit either — committee re-adjudicates).
